title: “High Speed” by just Min captures the thrill of letting go and racing toward freedom
htmlContent: Emerging alt-pop artist just Min turns up the excitement and emotional depth with their latest single, "High Speed." This track is the third release from their upcoming debut EP and feels like a thrilling ride that captures the mix of chaos and clarity that comes from breaking free. "High Speed" grabs your attention with its strong bassline, creating a sense of urgency. The song reflects the intense emotions that come with moving on, it's painful yet necessary, and ultimately exhilarating. just Min's vocals stand out with their honesty, cutting through the bold music. You can sense the struggle between feeling lost and embracing newfound freedom. When the heaviness of those emotions starts to weigh you down, the music lifts you up, taking you forward. https://open.spotify.com/track/2Myo80DoFzSH5gGJV06rT0 "High Speed" is both a breakup song and a song of freedom. It beautifully captures the messy feelings of letting go, where heartbreak and relief come together in the whirlwind of change. With this release, just Min showcases their talent for mixing deep emotions with infectious energy, making "High Speed" for anyone who has needed to escape their past. Follow on: Instagram/TikTok
